## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete trigger, current problem, and what this change makes possible.

## Validation

List the relevant commands and results. For a bug, describe the regression fixture. For a visual change, include before/after images and verify selected exports when affected.

## Compatibility and limits

Note graph-schema or MCP contract changes, unsupported cases, and anything a reviewer should check. Confirm examples and artifacts contain no private source or credentials.
